description: List e-Factura messages from the last N days (ANAF allows at most 60). Each message has a kind (sent, received, error, buyerMessage), an id that download_invoice takes, a zoneless local timestamp, and details: the upload id, issuer CIF and beneficiary CIF lifted out of ANAF's prose. A notice field means ANAF refused rather than returned nothing.

cif.description: Defaults to the CIF in app.json. With or without the RO prefix; both are accepted.

test.description: Query ANAF's test environment instead of production.

name: list_invoices
title: List e-Factura messages
